shots.prompt_en: Create one continuous 8-second, 16:9 cinematic live-action image-to-video shot using the uploaded image as the exact first frame. Preserve the visible identities, clothing, prop sizes, lighting, screen axis and camera framing. Keep natural real-time human motion; no cuts, transitions, slow motion or time-lapse. Keep the fixed wide shot of the covered rainy bus stop AFTER the bus has gone. Preserve the wet pavement reflections, shelter and office background. The older stocky East Asian man with white curls, orange raincoat, navy shirt and brown shoes stands center-right, RIGHT hand on his upright gray suitcase with yellow ribbon, black phone concealed in his LEFT pocket. He looks toward the departed bus direction at SCREEN-RIGHT. The petite short-haired East Asian woman in teal rain jacket and black backpack stands to his left, white charger with pink cable band in her LEFT hand and pink phone in her RIGHT hand. Hold 0–1 seconds. From 1–4.5 seconds she gives him a small friendly parting smile, turns away from the road toward the office-side sidewalk to screen-left and rear, and walks calmly out of the shot along that safe pedestrian route, keeping one object in each hand. The man remains at the shelter with his suitcase, a slightly deflated romantic-film expression, not crying or punished. From 4.5–8 seconds hold the lone man and his luggage in the empty bus-stop scene. No new bus, new person, phone-to-charger swap, abandoned suitcase, woman crossing the vehicle lane, departure chase, camera movement or text. No dialogue, narration, lip-synced speech, subtitles, written graphics, logos or generated music. Quiet nonverbal location sound is optional; all narrative captions, interface graphics, music and sound cues will be added in postproduction. End with a physically stable pose, with only natural breathing, blinking and environmental motion.
